info.title: Compliance — Internal DNC Add
info.description: Add a phone to the org's internal Do-Not-Call suppression list. Owned by Agent C.

post.summary: Add a phone to the internal DNC list

201.description: Phone recorded (or already present) on the internal DNC list

403.description: Brief 50 (PR 16, moved to the middleware for every save by PR 18), engineering precaution: a request that didn't come from the CRM's own pages (Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site or same-site; otherwise an Origin whose host isn't this request's host, or Origin null; with no Origin, a Sec-Fetch-Site other than same-origin or none, or a Referer from another host; or none of Origin, Sec-Fetch-Site and Referer). Answered by the middleware before this route runs, so nothing is read or written. Body: {"error": "Refused: this change didn't come from the CRM's own pages. Open the CRM and try again.", "code": "cross_site_request"}. A script sends the Basic-auth password and an Origin header matching the CRM's address.

addedBy.description: Optional free-text label for who or what added the number, stored as sent on a new entry (re-adding a number changes nothing). It is not a User.id and is not checked. The CRM's Settings > Do not contact screen sends "settings-do-not-contact". When it is missing or not a string, "user-request" is stored. (SMS STOP and the Brief 41.1 sweep add in-process, not through this route, as "sms-inbound-handler" and "brief41-1-stop-sweep".)

added.description: false when the phone was already suppressed (idempotent).
